name: oasis-pool
description: Twenty-four seconds at 60 fps: once round the pool two metres over the sand 22 m out, looking at its middle, then low across it a metre and a half over the water and up the far shore. README.md says what each marker shows.

markers.name: east
markers.note: From the east shore, the sun behind: the sky in the pool and the bottom fading from sand at the shore to blue-green in the middle.

markers.name: sun
markers.note: From the south-west shore towards the morning sun: its glitter on the waves, and the rocks of the far shore against it.

markers.name: across
markers.note: Low over the middle of the pool: the waves close up, the far shore's sand coming up through the shallows.
